name: SDN OMM JSON Encoder
description: Single-purpose flow node: decodes an ALIGNED size-prefixed $OMM FlatBuffer stream (concatenated [u32le length][$OMM buffer] frames, as produced by the data-source/retrieval omm_bulk 'stream' port) into one JSON frame {"records":[{"norad_cat_id","object_name","object_id","epoch","mean_motion","eccentricity","inclination"}],"count":N}. Absent OMM string fields serialize as JSON null; doubles use round-trip (%.17g) formatting. Pure compute — no capabilities.

acceptedTypeSets.description: ALIGNED size-prefixed $OMM FlatBuffer stream: concatenated [u32le length][$OMM buffer] frames (zero-length prefixes tolerated as padding). An empty payload encodes as zero records.

inputPorts.description: Size-prefixed $OMM stream to encode (verbatim output of data-source/retrieval omm_bulk).

acceptedTypeSets.description: UTF-8 JSON bytes {"records":[...],"count":N} carried with the aligned-binary wire format (alignment 1). SDK manifest rules cannot express a JSON-bytes type, so the port declares the generic flatbuffer ref; runtime frames carry aligned-binary TAB descriptors.

outputPorts.description: One JSON frame per input stream.

methods.description: Decodes every size-prefixed $OMM frame (identifier + verifier checked per frame) and emits one JSON frame with the seven summary fields per record.
